# EcoGreen Roofing And Exteriors

> EcoGreen Roofing And Exteriors is a licensed and insured roofing and exterior contractor whose team brings 25+ years of experience, serving homes and businesses across Southeastern Pennsylvania, South Jersey and Northern Delaware. Five local teams handle roof replacement, roof repair, siding, gutters, windows, doors and exterior renovation, with free written estimates and a workmanship warranty on every job.

## Key facts
- Services: roof replacement (full tear-off), roof repair, storm damage repair, standing seam metal roofs, flat and low-slope roofs (EPDM, TPO, modified bitumen), slate and cedar shake repair, siding installation and repair, gutter installation and repair, window replacement, entry and patio doors, exterior renovation
- Experience: team with 25+ years of experience; licensed and insured
- Licenses: Pennsylvania HIC #PA209178; New Jersey HIC #13VH14032800
- Estimates: free, in writing, no pressure; permits handled for the customer
- Typical roof replacement: one to two days for most single-family homes
- Warranty: workmanship warranty on every job, plus manufacturer warranty on materials
- Reviews: 5.0 stars on Google
- Main phone: (888) 494-1248
- Website: https://ecogreenextrior.com/

## Locations
- Bala Cynwyd, PA: 45 E City Ave, Bala Cynwyd, PA 19004, (484) 992-8649 (Main Line, Chester and Delaware counties, New Castle County DE)
- Doylestown, PA: 196 W Ashland St, Doylestown, PA 18901, (215) 598-6455 (Bucks County)
- Huntingdon Valley, PA: service area, (267) 377-4597 (Montgomery County)
- Philadelphia, PA: 4030 N Broad St, Philadelphia, PA 19140, (215) 883-8037
- Sewell, NJ: 101 Raymond Dr, Sewell, NJ 08080, (856) 242-7123 (South Jersey)

## Service areas
- Pennsylvania: Philadelphia, Montgomery, Bucks, Chester and Delaware counties
- New Jersey: Camden, Burlington, Gloucester and Salem counties
- Delaware: New Castle County

## Services
- [Roofing](https://ecogreenextrior.com/roofing-services/): roof installation, replacement and repairs
- [Roof Replacement](https://ecogreenextrior.com/roof-replacement/): full tear-off, new decking, ice and water shield, shingle, metal or flat roofs
- [Roof Repair](https://ecogreenextrior.com/roof-repair/): leaks, storm damage, flashing and shingle repairs
- [Emergency & Storm Damage Roof Repair](https://ecogreenextrior.com/emergency-roof-repair/): emergency tarping, storm damage, insurance claim help
- [Flat Roof Repair](https://ecogreenextrior.com/flat-roof-repair/): EPDM, TPO and modified bitumen flat roofs on Philadelphia row homes
- [Slate & Cedar Roof Repair](https://ecogreenextrior.com/slate-roof-repair/): slate and cedar shake repair for older and historic homes
- [Siding](https://ecogreenextrior.com/siding-services/): siding installation, replacement and repairs
- [Windows](https://ecogreenextrior.com/window-services/): window replacement and installation
- [Gutters](https://ecogreenextrior.com/gutters-service/): gutter installation, replacement and repair
- [Doors](https://ecogreenextrior.com/door-services/): entry and patio door installation
- [Exterior Work](https://ecogreenextrior.com/exterior-work/): exterior renovations and improvements
